title: Agnostic Model-Assisted Estimation with Machine Learning for Survey Data
summary: Model-assisted estimation uses prediction rules to improve the efficiency of estimators of finite population parameters while retaining design-based inference. Although flexible prediction methods have been considered, existing theoretical results are largely method-specific. We develop a learner-agnostic framework that replaces separate analyses for individual learners with general conditions on the sampling design and prediction error.
